title: Wishlane: Wishlists & Gifts
subtitle: Wishlists, shared beautifully
shortDescription: Create wishlists, share them with friends, and reserve gifts in secret.
promoText: Paste any link, build a beautiful wishlist, and share it with friends. They reserve gifts in secret - so nobody buys the same present and no surprise gets spoiled.
intro: Wishlane turns "so, what do you actually want?" into something everyone enjoys.
Create beautiful wishlists, share them with the people who matter, and let them reserve gifts in secret - so nobody buys the same thing twice and no surprise gets spoiled.

sections.heading: Create a wishlist in seconds
sections.body: Paste any product link and Wishlane fills in the title, description, image and price for you. Name your list, pick an accent colour, set an event date, and you're done.

sections.heading: Share on your terms
sections.body: Every wishlist is public, friends-only, or completely private. Send a link to anyone, or connect with friends by username - you'll see their lists, they'll see yours.

sections.heading: Reserve gifts secretly
sections.body: Reserve an item on a friend's list and everyone else can see it's taken - but the owner never finds out. No duplicate presents, no ruined surprises.

sections.heading: Secret Santa, organised
sections.body: Create a group, invite everyone with a single link, and let Wishlane run the draw. Each person sees their match's wishlist, so the gifts actually land.

sections.heading: Discover what people want
sections.body: Browse your friends' public wishlists, see upcoming birthdays and events with countdowns, and never show up empty-handed again.

sections.heading: Stay in the loop
sections.body: Get notified when a friend adds a wishlist, sends you a request, or reserves something from yours.

sections.heading: Wishlane Premium
sections.body: Upgrade for unlimited lists and items, collaborator access on shared lists, sale alerts that track price drops, and custom colours and priorities.

closing: Wishlane is free to start - no credit card, set up in under a minute. Available in 40+ languages.

You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID account settings at any time.
